question.prompt: In right triangles \(ABC\) and \(DEF\), \(\angle C=\angle F=90^\circ\), \(AB=DE\), \(AC=DF\), and \(\angle A=35^\circ\). Find the measure of \(\angle E\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: \(AB=DE\) (hypotenuses) and \(AC=DF\) (legs), so \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF\) by HL. \(\angle E\) corresponds to \(\angle B\), and \(\angle B=90^\circ-35^\circ=55^\circ\). Therefore, \(\angle E=55^\circ\).
solutions.title: HL and complementary acute angles
